slides.title: Board grade written?
slides.body: BWP for wet areas, MR for dry. If the quote says only “ply”, ask.

slides.title: Hardware brand named?
slides.body: Hinges and channels decide how the kitchen feels after 2 years.

slides.title: Edge banding included?
slides.body: Machine-pressed edges don't peel. Hand-glued ones do.

slides.title: Design freeze date
slides.body: Changes after cutting starts add days and cost. Freeze first.

slides.title: Handover checklist
slides.body: Snag list, cleaning, warranty card. In writing.
